id.description: Null when the value comes from defaults

email.description: Only exposed to the account owner and administrators

onTimeCount.description: Completed orders that ended within the scheduled window

dateOfBirth.description: Only exposed to the account owner

hours.description: Auto-expire the block after this many hours

idToken.description: Google ID token from the client SDK

devCode.description: Only present when SMTP is unconfigured and EXPOSE_OTP is enabled

resetToken.description: Token accepted by /auth/password/reset; only returned for PASSWORD_RESET

token.description: Token delivered by email (or returned directly in development)

favoriteCount.description: How many players marked this game as a favorite

availableBalance.description: VND ready to spend or withdraw

pendingBalance.description: VND held until the next release

released.description: Credits that matured and moved into the available balance

today.description: VND earned today in the app timezone

thisMonth.description: VND earned since the first day of the current month

total.description: VND earned since the account was created

paymentUrl.description: Redirect the user here to pay

mock.description: True when the payment adapter is running in mock mode

gameIds.description: Games the player must be skilled at

playerPayout.description: VND paid to the player after the platform fee

points.description: Behavior points to deduct from the target

satisfaction.description: Satisfaction points to deduct from the target

disableAccount.description: Lock the target account and revoke its sessions

refundAmount.description: Amount clawed back from the player and refunded to the hirer

mine.description: True when the caller sent the message

searches.description: How many times the query was recorded in the trending window

recipients.description: Number of users who received the notification
